result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout problem where content is obscured by the bottom navigation, and one minor readability issue in the promo banner.

issues.description: The next restaurant card is cut off behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making part of the content inaccessible in this view.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scroll area so the last visible card clears the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The promotional banner text is very low contrast against the pale green background, especially the smaller subtext.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast by darkening the text color or slightly deepening the banner background.
